profiles.name: 0. Repo Scout
args: Map the repository for this card using `ast-grep` and `rtk`. Write ONLY `openspec/changes/<slug>/context-map.md` (impacted files, symbol line ranges, type signatures, test commands). Do not modify application code.

profiles.name: 1. Briefing (Gate 1)
args: Read the card request and `context-map.md` if present. If there is critical ambiguity, list objective clarifying questions. Otherwise create ONLY `openspec/changes/<slug>/proposal.md` containing: Executive Summary, In-Scope, Out-of-Scope, Formal EARS Requirements, and Planned Stages. Do NOT generate code or full specs yet. Stop for Human Gate 1 review.

profiles.name: 2. Spec + Visual Mockup (Gate 2)
args: The `proposal.md` has been approved at Gate 1. Execute `/opsx:propose` to generate `specs/`, `tasks.md` (with explicit Spec-First TDD test cases per task), and (only for COMPLEX_CODE/DEEP_ARCH) `design.md`. If `has_frontend_ui` is active, also generate the self-contained interactive `ui-mockup.html` using Tailwind CSS via CDN. Validate strictly with `openspec validate --strict` and stop for Human Gate 2 review.

profiles.name: 3. Implement Code (/opsx:apply)
args: The specifications and visual mockup have been approved at Gate 2. Execute `/opsx:apply` by sequentially implementing each checklist item in `openspec/changes/<slug>/tasks.md` with Spec-First TDD. After each item, run the domain's local Zero-Token gate (`gcc`/`make`, `dotnet test`, `pytest`, or `npx tsc --noEmit`) until exit code 0, then mark `[x]`. Never edit `specs/`.

profiles.name: 4. Code & Spec Review Gate
args: Audit `git diff` against every `SHALL` clause in `openspec/changes/<slug>/specs/`, verify package/lockfile integrity, hunt TODO/stubs/weak asserts. Write `STATUS: APPROVED` or `STATUS: REJECTED` (with file:line items) to `openspec/changes/<slug>/code-review-report.md`. Read-only on source code.

profiles.name: 5. Visual & Functional QA (/opsx:verify)
args: Run `/opsx:verify`. Use the dynamic port in `$QA_PORT` (never :3000/:5000/:8000). Visual QA via Playwright MCP when the change has a UI, otherwise black-box functional QA of the API/CLI. Write evidence and `STATUS: APPROVED` or `STATUS: REJECTED` to `openspec/changes/<slug>/qa-report.md` and terminate every process you spawned.
